name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin)
summary: A rural sanitation mission that provides a financial incentive to Below Poverty Line households in villages to construct and use an individual household toilet.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must live in a rural area.
The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.

entitlement_rules.text: An eligible household receives an incentive of Rs. 12000 for constructing a toilet.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the village level.
